strings.zh: 雪城『说得通？
strings.en: Sammy: Explains it?

strings.zh: 桐树林附近的居民间{NEWLINE}流传着这样的传说：{CLEAR}森林之神雪拉比{CLEAR}能够自由地穿梭于不同时空。{SCROLL}你说刚才跟雪拉比遇到危险,{NEWLINE}那么情急之下,雪拉比可能为了保护你,{CLEAR}就带着你一起从40年前穿越过来了。
strings.en: The people living near Ilex Forest{NEWLINE}have a legend: Celebi, the god of the{CLEAR}forest, can travel freely through time.{SCROLL}You say you and Celebi were in danger{NEWLINE}just now. So in a pinch, Celebi may{CLEAR}have brought you along to protect{CLEAR}you, all the way from 40 years ago.

strings.zh: 雪城『带着我穿越了？{NEWLINE}这么说雪拉比也一起来到了这个时空？
strings.en: Sammy: It brought me through time?{NEWLINE}So Celebi came to this time too?

strings.zh: 有可能吧,{NEWLINE}毕竟雪拉比穿越时空只是传说。{CLEAR}没有人知道具体的细节。{SCROLL}你穿越之前最后一次看到雪拉比,{NEWLINE}是在哪里？
strings.en: Maybe. After all, Celebi’s{NEWLINE}time travel is only a legend.{CLEAR}Nobody knows the details.{SCROLL}Where did you last see Celebi{NEWLINE}before you came through?

strings.zh: 雪城『就是在前面的时光森林,{NEWLINE}我和雪拉比被坏人追,{CLEAR}然后白光一闪我就到了这里。
strings.en: Sammy: In the Forest of Time up ahead.{NEWLINE}Celebi and I were being chased by{CLEAR}bad guys, and then there was a flash{CLEAR}of white light and I ended up here.

strings.zh: 那咱们就去时光森林看看,{NEWLINE}或许雪拉比就在那里。
strings.en: Then let’s go look in the Forest{NEWLINE}of Time. Maybe Celebi is there.

strings.zh: 雪城『好的,婆婆……{NEWLINE}哦不,姐姐！
strings.en: Sammy: Okay, Granny... I mean, Big Sis!

strings.zh: 哈哈,走吧。
strings.en: Ha ha, let’s go.

strings.zh: 哦哦,这不是是冠军大人嘛？{NEWLINE}今天怎么有空来桐树林玩了？
strings.en: Oh ho, isn’t this the Champion? What{NEWLINE}brings you to Ilex Forest today?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『火箭队最近{NEWLINE}在捕捉传说中的精灵,{CLEAR}为了提前阻止他们的阴谋,{CLEAR}我特地来桐树林看看有没有异常。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Team Rocket has been catching{NEWLINE}legendary Pokémon lately. I came to{CLEAR}check Ilex Forest for anything unusual,{CLEAR}to stop their scheme ahead of time.

strings.zh: 哈哈,我们桐树林有森林之神雪拉比{NEWLINE}和净化一切的洁咪守护,{CLEAR}那些大坏蛋才不敢来……
strings.en: Ha ha, our Ilex Forest is protected{NEWLINE}by Celebi, god of the forest, and by{CLEAR}Shaymin, which purifies everything.{CLEAR}Those crooks wouldn’t dare come...

strings.zh: 冠军大人啊,森林之神雪拉比{NEWLINE}在它原来的时空似乎遇到了麻烦,{CLEAR}您有时间的话也来看看是怎么回事吧。
strings.en: Champion, it seems Celebi, god of{NEWLINE}the forest, has run into trouble{CLEAR}in its own time. If you have time,{CLEAR}please come and see what’s going on.

strings.zh: 你好啊,冠军大人。我后面这片树林{NEWLINE}是被称为林中之林的时光森林,{CLEAR}据说森林之神雪拉比就住在里面。{SCROLL}不过这都是我年轻当护林员时{NEWLINE}听来的传说,做不得准的。
strings.en: Hello, Champion. The woods behind me{NEWLINE}are the forest within the forest,{CLEAR}the Forest of Time. They say Celebi,{CLEAR}god of the forest, lives inside.{SCROLL}But those are just legends I heard{NEWLINE}back when I was a young ranger. I{CLEAR}wouldn’t put too much stock in them.

strings.zh: 雪拉比居然能跟传说的一样穿越时空,{NEWLINE}真是太神奇了。
strings.en: Celebi really can travel through time,{NEWLINE}just like the legend says. How amazing.

strings.zh: 小梅『小女子名叫小梅,{NEWLINE}乃是缘朱市的一名舞女,{CLEAR}今日与舍妹相约在桐树林北出口见面,{CLEAR}不料却在此迷了路。{CLEAR}敢问尊驾可知如何离开这片森林？
strings.en: Koume: This humble maiden is named{NEWLINE}Koume, a Kimono Girl of Ecruteak{CLEAR}City. Today I was to meet my younger{CLEAR}sister at the north exit of Ilex{CLEAR}Forest, but I have lost my way. May{CLEAR}I ask, honored traveler, whether{CLEAR}you know how to leave this forest?
strings.notes: 小梅 = Koume (Kimono Girl, archaic speech; 小女子 → ‘this humble maiden’ as Tamao, 尊驾 → ‘honored traveler’). Menu #93-#95 directions; #103/#104 lead her out or not.

strings.zh: 向前直走
strings.en: Go straight ahead

strings.zh: 向北拐弯

strings.zh: 我路不熟,别问我
strings.en: Don’t know the way, don’t ask

strings.zh: 小梅『原来如此,多谢尊驾指点迷津。{NEWLINE}小女子还要去森林出口与舍妹汇合,{CLEAR}就先与尊驾别过了。
strings.en: Koume: I see. Many thanks for showing{NEWLINE}me the way, honored traveler.{CLEAR}This humble maiden must go meet{CLEAR}her sister at the forest exit,{CLEAR}so I shall take my leave of you.

strings.zh: 小梅『唉,小女子在此地几经折返,{NEWLINE}仍未找到离开之法。{CLEAR}这可如何是好啊……
strings.en: Koume: Alas, this humble maiden{NEWLINE}has doubled back here time and{CLEAR}again, yet still cannot find the{CLEAR}way out. Whatever shall I do...

strings.zh: 小梅『竟让尊驾与舍妹如此费心,{NEWLINE}小女子当真羞愧万分。{CLEAR}尊驾不辞劳苦的一片热情,{CLEAR}小女子感激不尽。{CLEAR}烦请尊驾这就引小女子出去吧。
strings.en: Koume: To have troubled you and{NEWLINE}my sister so... This humble maiden{CLEAR}is truly ashamed. Your tireless{CLEAR}kindness, honored traveler, leaves{CLEAR}me endlessly grateful. Might I{CLEAR}trouble you to lead me out now?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『小梅小姐,从这里出去{NEWLINE}就可以离开桐树林了,{CLEAR}你的妹妹就在前面通道等你。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Miss Koume, this way leads{NEWLINE}out of Ilex Forest. Your sister is{CLEAR}waiting for you in the passage up ahead.

strings.zh: 小梅『如此劳烦尊驾,{NEWLINE}小女子实在过意不去。{CLEAR}这点小礼物是小女子的一片心意,{CLEAR}请尊驾收下吧。
strings.en: Koume: To trouble you so, honored{NEWLINE}traveler... This humble maiden feels{CLEAR}truly sorry. This small gift is a token{CLEAR}of my gratitude. Please accept it.

strings.zh: 小梅『小女子这就去与妹妹会合,{NEWLINE}改日再与尊驾相见。
strings.en: Koume: This humble maiden shall{NEWLINE}go meet her sister now. Until we{CLEAR}meet again, honored traveler.

strings.zh: 小梅『小女子天生路痴,{NEWLINE}虽承蒙尊驾指点,却依然迷路,{CLEAR}内心甚是羞愧。{SCROLL}小梅『请容小女子在此稍事休息,{NEWLINE}之后再慢慢寻找出路。
strings.en: Koume: This humble maiden was{NEWLINE}born with no sense of direction.{CLEAR}Even with your guidance I still{CLEAR}lost my way. I am deeply ashamed.{SCROLL}Koume: Please allow me to rest{NEWLINE}here a while. I shall look for{CLEAR}the way out slowly afterward.

strings.zh: 你妹妹让我带你出去
strings.en: Your sister sent me for you

strings.zh: 你自己想办法出去吧
strings.en: Find your own way out

strings.zh: 以前有位爱用头撞树的大哥,{NEWLINE}在这里把树叶撞得簌簌落下。{CLEAR}我在看落叶的时候,突然想出了一个{CLEAR}用空中飞舞的叶子攻击的招式,{CLEAR}叫作「飞叶风暴」。{SCROLL}你如果有精灵想学这招飞叶风暴的话,{NEWLINE}只要给我一个叶之石,{CLEAR}我就可以教你哦。{SCROLL}怎么样,要学吗？
strings.en: There used to be a guy here who loved{NEWLINE}to headbutt trees and knock the leaves{CLEAR}down in showers. Watching the falling{CLEAR}leaves, I suddenly came up with a{CLEAR}move that attacks with leaves whirling{CLEAR}through the air. I call it Leaf Storm.{SCROLL}If you have a Pokémon that wants{NEWLINE}to learn Leaf Storm, just give me{CLEAR}a Leaf Stone and I’ll teach it.{SCROLL}So, want to learn it?

strings.en: {VAR:0101:0} wants to{NEWLINE}learn Leaf Storm...!{SCROLL}But {VAR:0101:0} already{NEWLINE}knows four moves!{SCROLL}Should it forget a move{NEWLINE}to learn Leaf Storm?{VAR:0200:0}

strings.zh: 我是谁？我在哪？
strings.en: Who am I? Where am I?

strings.zh: 抱歉,我以前总是拿头撞树,{NEWLINE}以此来练习头突技能,{CLEAR}结果把脑袋撞得不好使了。{SCROLL}你年纪轻轻的{NEWLINE}可得注意保护自己的脑袋啊,{CLEAR}这个头盔你拿着,{CLEAR}想用头撞树的时候就带上它吧。
strings.en: Sorry. I used to headbutt trees{NEWLINE}all the time to practice Headbutt,{CLEAR}and I knocked my brain loose.{SCROLL}You’re still young, so take care{NEWLINE}of your head. Here, take this{CLEAR}helmet. Put it on whenever you{CLEAR}feel like headbutting a tree.

strings.zh: 我再也不拿头撞树了……
strings.en: I’ll never headbutt a tree again...

strings.zh: 线球『Spiii——na！{SCROLL}线球很高兴。
strings.en: Spinarak: Spiii-na!{SCROLL}Spinarak looks happy.

strings.zh: 我在桐树林找了好久,{NEWLINE}都没有找到虫精灵。{CLEAR}唉,好想抓一只虫精灵当伙伴啊。
strings.en: I’ve searched Ilex Forest for ages{NEWLINE}and haven’t found a single Bug{CLEAR}Pokémon. Sigh... I really want to{CLEAR}catch a Bug Pokémon as a partner.

strings.zh: 我为了抓虫精灵而来到桐树林,{NEWLINE}可这里根本没有虫精灵。{CLEAR}正当我为此发愁的时候,{CLEAR}这只超可爱的小线球就出现了。{SCROLL}嘿嘿,这就是上天赐给我的伙伴吧,{NEWLINE}我会好好照顾它,跟它一起变强！
strings.en: I came to Ilex Forest to catch{NEWLINE}Bug Pokémon, but there weren’t{CLEAR}any here at all. Just when I{CLEAR}was getting down about it, this{CLEAR}super-cute little Spinarak showed up.{SCROLL}Heh heh, it must be a partner sent{NEWLINE}from heaven! I’ll take good care of{CLEAR}it and we’ll get strong together!

strings.zh: 别人都说什么寂静之桥啊、{NEWLINE}32号路啊是钓鱼圣地,{CLEAR}可是据我所知{CLEAR}有人在寂静之桥用雷电球炸鱼,{CLEAR}32号路铺了铁轨经常过火车。{SCROLL}所以说这些地方都远不如{NEWLINE}这安静的桐树林适合钓鱼。
strings.en: People say Silence Bridge and Route 32{NEWLINE}are the holy grounds of fishing. But{CLEAR}as far as I know, someone at Silence{CLEAR}Bridge blasts the fish with Voltorb,{CLEAR}and Route 32 has railroad tracks{CLEAR}with trains running by all the time.{SCROLL}So none of those spots are{NEWLINE}anywhere near as good for{CLEAR}fishing as quiet Ilex Forest.
strings.notes: 寂静之桥 = Silence Bridge (glossary place); 雷电球 = Voltorb.

strings.zh: 刚刚钓到了不错的精灵,{NEWLINE}用它来一场对战吧！
strings.en: I just fished up a nice{NEWLINE}Pokémon. Let’s battle with it!

strings.zh: 呼呼……跟你对战好累啊。
strings.en: Phew... Battling you is exhausting.

strings.zh: 你好,冠军大人。{NEWLINE}为了防止桐树林再发生虫灾,{CLEAR}精灵联盟特意增派我们来当护林员,{CLEAR}由我们负责保护桐树林的生态。
strings.en: Hello, Champion. To keep another{NEWLINE}bug plague from hitting Ilex Forest,{CLEAR}the Pokémon League sent us here as{CLEAR}extra rangers. We’re in charge of{CLEAR}protecting the forest’s ecosystem.

strings.zh: 当护林员的日子好无聊啊,{NEWLINE}你陪我来场对战怎么样。
strings.en: Life as a ranger is so boring.{NEWLINE}How about a battle with me?

strings.zh: 呀！对战完才发现是冠军大人,{NEWLINE}难怪我不是对手呢。
strings.en: Eek! I only realized you were the{NEWLINE}Champion after the battle. No{CLEAR}wonder I was no match for you.

strings.zh: 在桐树林当护林员蛮清闲的,{NEWLINE}我要利用号这段时间{CLEAR}磨练自己的对战技巧。
strings.en: Being a ranger in Ilex Forest is{NEWLINE}pretty relaxed. I’m going to use{CLEAR}the time to sharpen my battle skills.

strings.zh: 又是路过的训练家来挑战啊,{NEWLINE}我躲到这里都躲不过去吗？{SCROLL}行吧,打就打。{NEWLINE}你想单打还是双打？
strings.en: Another passing Trainer here{NEWLINE}to challenge me? I can’t even{CLEAR}get away by hiding out here?{SCROLL}Fine, let’s battle. Singles or doubles?

strings.zh: 哥哥你好,这是我刚刚捉的线球,{NEWLINE}我还没有跟它一起并肩作战过,{CLEAR}你愿意当我们的第一个对手吗？

strings.en: Thanks, miss! Here we come!

strings.zh: 哥哥你好厉害哦,{NEWLINE}我们完全不是对手。{CLEAR}不过虽然我们输掉了,{CLEAR}但我觉得线球还是很有潜力的,{CLEAR}我会好好培育它跟它一起变强！
strings.en: Mister, you’re so strong! We were{NEWLINE}no match for you at all. But even{CLEAR}though we lost, I think Spinarak has{CLEAR}lots of potential. I’ll raise it well{CLEAR}and get strong together with it!

strings.zh: 姐姐你好厉害哦,{NEWLINE}我们完全不是对手。{CLEAR}不过虽然我们输掉了,{CLEAR}但我觉得线球还是很有潜力的,{CLEAR}我会好好培育它跟它一起变强！

strings.zh: 你好,我是桐树林的护林员。{NEWLINE}我的职责是带着杰尼龟们{CLEAR}做好桐树林的消防工作。{SCROLL}最近有一只流浪的戴鲁比{NEWLINE}进入了桐树林,{CLEAR}这种火系精灵很可能引发火灾,{CLEAR}本来发生这种事{CLEAR}应该由我们消防护林员出动抓捕,{CLEAR}但是我的杰尼龟们腿太短{CLEAR}试了好几次都追不上戴鲁比,{CLEAR}如果你有看到戴鲁比,{CLEAR}请帮忙顺道抓住它好吗？
strings.en: Hello, I’m an Ilex Forest ranger.{NEWLINE}My job is fire prevention in{CLEAR}the forest with my Squirtle.{SCROLL}Recently a stray Houndour wandered{NEWLINE}into Ilex Forest. A Fire type like{CLEAR}that could easily start a fire.{CLEAR}Normally we fire rangers would go{CLEAR}and catch it, but my Squirtle’s legs{CLEAR}are too short. They tried again and{CLEAR}again and couldn’t catch up with it.{CLEAR}If you see the Houndour, could you{CLEAR}catch it for me while you’re at it?

strings.zh: 哇,你已经抓到了戴鲁比？{NEWLINE}真的是太感谢了,{CLEAR}这样桐树林就没有火灾的后顾之忧了。{SCROLL}作为回报请你收下这个礼物吧。
strings.en: Wow, you already caught the Houndour?{NEWLINE}Thank you so much! Now we don’t have{CLEAR}to worry about fires in Ilex Forest.{SCROLL}Please take this gift as thanks.

strings.zh: 我在当护林员的日子里,{NEWLINE}听了很多关于桐树林的传说,{CLEAR}据说桐树林的洁咪{CLEAR}跟叶精灵是非常要好的朋友,{CLEAR}同时洁咪呢,又跟雪拉比是{CLEAR}非常要好的朋友。
strings.en: In my years as a ranger, I’ve heard{NEWLINE}lots of legends about Ilex Forest.{CLEAR}They say Shaymin of Ilex Forest is{CLEAR}close friends with Leafeon, and Shaymin{CLEAR}is also close friends with Celebi.

strings.zh: 戴鲁比已经折服于你的力量,{NEWLINE}要收服它吗？
strings.en: Houndour has submitted to{NEWLINE}your strength. Catch it?

strings.zh: 阿金『偶像！
strings.en: Gold: Idol!

strings.zh: 阿金『终于追上你了。{SCROLL}阿金『我跟你说,我已经拿到{NEWLINE}第二枚道馆徽章了。{CLEAR}嘿嘿,你现在有几枚{CLEAR}城都地区的徽章了呢？
strings.en: Gold: Finally caught up with you.{SCROLL}Gold: Guess what, I already got{NEWLINE}my second Gym Badge. Heh heh, how{CLEAR}many Johto Badges do you have now?
strings.notes: Badge count branch: #161 two / #162 one / #163 none → #164 / #166 / #167.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我也收集到了2枚{NEWLINE}城都地区的徽章。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I’ve collected{NEWLINE}two Johto Badges too.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我目前只有1枚{NEWLINE}城都地区的徽章。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I only have{NEWLINE}one Johto Badge so far.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我现在还没有{NEWLINE}城都地区的徽章。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I don’t have{NEWLINE}any Johto Badges yet.

strings.zh: 阿金『真不愧是我的偶像,{NEWLINE}看来我得再加把劲{CLEAR}才能赢得这场徽章收集比赛。
strings.en: Gold: That’s my idol for you.{NEWLINE}Looks like I’ll have to try even{CLEAR}harder to win our Badge race.

strings.zh: 阿金『我现在要朝满金市出发{NEWLINE}去收集下一枚徽章。{CLEAR}偶像你要是不想输掉比赛{CLEAR}就快点跟上来吧！
strings.en: Gold: I’m heading for Goldenrod City{NEWLINE}now to get my next Badge. Idol, if{CLEAR}you don’t want to lose the race,{CLEAR}you’d better hurry and catch up!

strings.zh: 阿金『嘿嘿,目前是我领先,{NEWLINE}偶像你可得加把劲了哦。
strings.en: Gold: Heh heh, I’m in the lead for{NEWLINE}now. Idol, you’d better step it up.

strings.zh: 阿金『什么嘛,偶像你是不是{NEWLINE}没有把跟我的比赛放在心上啊。{CLEAR}这样赢了你可一点意思都没有。
strings.en: Gold: What the heck, Idol? You’re not{NEWLINE}taking our race seriously, are you?{CLEAR}Beating you like this is no fun at all.

strings.zh: 水晶『{VAR:0103:0}前辈,我的月桂蹦{NEWLINE}来到桐树林之后特别兴奋,{CLEAR}感觉这里好像是它的故乡呢。{SCROLL}水晶『看到月桂蹦高兴的样子,{NEWLINE}我突然发现出来旅行的意义{CLEAR}不只是收集图鉴、锻炼本领。{SCROLL}水晶『跟精灵们一起创造{NEWLINE}美好的回忆同样重要。
strings.en: Crystal: {VAR:0103:0}, ever since{NEWLINE}we got to Ilex Forest, my{CLEAR}Baylee has been so excited. It{CLEAR}feels like this is its hometown.{SCROLL}Crystal: Seeing Baylee so happy,{NEWLINE}I suddenly realized traveling{CLEAR}isn’t only about filling the{CLEAR}Pokédex and building up skills.{SCROLL}Crystal: Making happy{NEWLINE}memories together with your{CLEAR}Pokémon is just as important.

strings.zh: 水晶『哎呀,稍微有点感悟{NEWLINE}就忍不住向前辈倾诉,真是不好意思。{SCROLL}水晶『我的爷爷奶奶{NEWLINE}就在前边的34号路开饲育屋,{CLEAR}我现在正好顺路去看看他们。{CLEAR}前辈要是对饲育屋感兴趣的话{CLEAR}欢迎去看看哦。
strings.en: Crystal: Oh, I got a little sentimental{NEWLINE}and couldn’t help pouring my heart{CLEAR}out to you. Sorry about that.{SCROLL}Crystal: My grandpa and grandma run{NEWLINE}the Day-Care on Route 34 up ahead.{CLEAR}I’m going to drop by and see them{CLEAR}on the way. If you’re interested{CLEAR}in the Day-Care, come take a look!
